'''Chancellor''' was the title bestowed upon the leader of the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Council of Elders]]. By [[44 ABY]], [[Darima Kedari]] had become the Council's Chancellor.<ref name="CSS">''{{Ab|Fate of the Jedi: Allies (audiobook)}}''</ref>
